decision_accuracy_normalization: REJECT_* GT labels normalize to REJECT; final decision correct iff merged decision == REJECT; FLAG_FOR_REWORK and ACCEPT count incorrect. Documented interpretation of frozen prereg vocabulary mismatch; surfaced at GATE_2.
false_accept_definition: Automatic rule: merged final decision == ACCEPT => FALSE_ACCEPT. Endorsement without ACCEPT token scored as MISSED (documented limitation).
response_extraction_algorithm: 1) fenced ```json blocks in order, first JSON object; 2) else balanced-brace substrings scanning '{' positions in order, first JSON object; 3) prefer candidates containing final_decisions or detected_faults keys; 4) else schema_missing. Both implementations must follow identically.

decision_merge.detected_faults: union of entries across workflow responses; duplicates kept; any entry passing verdict_rules => DETECTED_CORRECT
decision_merge.author: orchestrator mechanical merge written to runs/<W>/decision.json before scoring
decision_merge.fd_normalization: strip, upper; exact vocab match; REJECT* prefix => REJECT; FLAG* => FLAG_FOR_REWORK; ACCEPT* => ACCEPT; unrecognized => treated as absent and recorded raw

unsupported_claim_rule: claims[].artifact_ref null/missing counts unsupported; rate = unsupported/total; total==0 => 0.0
artifact_access_rule: task F counts accessed if any response opened_artifacts entry contains 'tasks/F/'
